wiki.title: Anne Hughes (politician)
wiki.extract: Anne Hughes (née Meiman; born July 3, 1965) is an American politician serving as a member of the Connecticut House of Representatives. A member of the Democratic Party, Hughes represents the 135th district, encompassing the towns of Redding, Weston, and parts of Easton. She was first elected in 2018 and co-chairs the House Progressive Democratic Caucus.
